question: What are the measured distances from earth to the pole star and from heaven to the great world?
premises: The span from earth up to the pole star is fifteen lakhs.
The span from heaven to the great world is two crores and eighty-five lakhs.
These figures summarize the vertical scale of the lower cosmic regions.
inference: The text gives precise numerical measures to map the vast distances between the major cosmic levels.
uncertainties: The unit of distance is not named in this verse, though lakhs and crores are standard yojana measures in this context.
plain_english: Thus, from the earth up to the Pole Star the distance is fifteen lakhs. From heaven up to the Great World it is two crores and eighty-five lakhs.
